subject: Q4 executive hiring authorization and offers
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 executive hiring authorization and offers

Team —

I'm sending the attached Q4 exec hiring packet for final authorization from the leadership team. High level: we are asking to clear two executive-level hires this quarter so we can hit FY27 go-to-market capacity targets:

- Head of Enterprise Sales (exec title, 1 FTE) — immediate start target Nov/Dec; candidate is Rebecca from CompCrafters (recruiting has verbal acceptance pending written). Compensation ask: base 325k + 60k OTE, equity 0.5% (band level: Exec-3).
- VP Product (internal replacement, promotion ladder) — backfill / upgrade; compensation band asks aligned to Exec-2 (base 265k + 45k OTE, equity 0.35%).

Attached: Q4_exec_headcount_plan_v3.pdf and comp_bands_2026_Q4.xlsx. Key asks: sign off on the offers as proposed and thumbs-up to move to formal written offers. If you approve, instruct finance to pull the requisitions and enable the standard exec offer packet with the garden-variety executive clauses (we will run separate exceptions if anyone requests additional signing bonus).

Decision timeline: please respond by EOD Tuesday (2026-10-06) — I know that's tight, but recruiting has windows with both candidates.

Notes:
- Recruiting (Monica) has confirmed references for Rebecca and confirms she is open to a start date in late November.
- Compensation bands are in the spreadsheet, and Markus has indicated we have bench budget under the recruiting reserve.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: Q4_exec_headcount_plan_v3.pdf (PDF, 412 KB), comp_bands_2026_Q4.xlsx (XLSX, 84 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:05:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 executive hiring authorization and offers

Vivek —

Quick read-through. Two small questions before I can sign off:

1) For Head of Enterprise Sales — is the OTE number you shared fully guaranteed or is 40% bonus at target? Want to make sure comp structure matches market for an exec hire that will be leading enterprise renewals.
2) VP Product — is this replacement being promoted from within? If internal, we should confirm the total comp delta and any compression on direct reports.

If Monica can drop the final proposed offer letter components (salary + target bonus phrasing) into the doc, I can approve this morning.

Thanks,
Laura

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 executive hiring authorization and offers

Vivek/Laura —

I reviewed the comp band spreadsheet and the proposed numbers look reasonable. We have $420k in the recruiting reserve for Q4 and these hires (as proposed) would use ~68% of that line after onboarding costs. I am comfortable approving the two offers at the suggested comp bands with the following conditions:

- No sign-on > 30k without explicit CFO/Finance approval.
- Any equity above the band should be routed through the compensation committee (CC) for exception.

If Laura confirms the OTE structure (and Monica pushes the formal offer language), I am good to sign off.

-Markus

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 12:40:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 executive hiring authorization and offers

All —

Following up with concrete offer language for Laura:

- Head of Enterprise Sales (Rebecca C.) — Base: $325,000; Target cash compensation (base + target bonus): $385,000 (target bonus 60k / ~18.5% of total cash); sign-on: $25,000 (one-time), equity: 0.50% subject to exec band approval. Start date: 11/30/2026. Candidate accepts conditioned on final paperwork.

- VP Product (internal promotion) — Base: $265,000; Target cash compensation: $310,000 (target bonus 45k); sign-on: none; equity: uplift to 0.35% per band. Effective date: 11/01/2026. Note: we'll run an internal comp compression analysis before the promotion is processed.

Attached is the offer_templates_v2.docx and I've pushed signed reference notes into the Drive folder. If you all greenlight, I'll send the formal offers this afternoon.

Thanks, Monica
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — good alignment.

Per Markus' conditions and Laura's ask, Monica: proceed with the formal offer letters using the language you included. Limit sign-on to $25k for Rebecca (under the 30k threshold). We'll route any equity exceptions to CC if requested. Laura, please flag any compression issues once you run the analysis — if there are material comp shifts we can re-evaluate before the promotion is finalized.

Tessa — please set up requisitions in Workday/Finance (req codes: will follow in separate message) and loop in payroll so the start/perf cycle timing is correct. Monica, send offers this afternoon and copy me.

I'll mark this thread as approved for Q4 exec hiring.

— Vivek
